codec_constraints.constraint: UACP HEL final message with protocol version 0, None-profile buffers >=8192, message/chunk limits and non-null EndpointUrl whose complete signed-Int32 encoding is <4096 bytes.
UACP ACK final message, protocol version0 and buffers>=8192. The separate executor negotiation constraint checks ACK receive/send limits against opposite HEL send/receive limits.
UACP ERR final message containing complete StatusCode and signed-length UTF-8 reason; closes the transport on the declared state edges.
Server-to-client UACP RHE in reverse-connect role, containing complete non-null ServerUri and EndpointUrl encodings each <4096 bytes; not a SecureChannel handshake by itself.
UASC OPN Issue request, namespace0 binary service ID446, zero channel, exact SecurityPolicy None, null certificate/thumbprint/nonce and null discovery authentication token; complete RequestHeader.
Successful UASC OPN response, namespace0 binary service ID449, complete ResponseHeader, matching channel/token channel, nonzero assigned channel/token/lifetime and null server nonce.
UASC MSG GetEndpoints request, namespace0 binary service ID428, bound channel/token and complete RequestHeader/EndpointUrl/LocaleIds/ProfileUris arrays; no Session required.
UASC MSG GetEndpoints successful response, namespace0 binary service ID431, complete ResponseHeader and bounded EndpointDescription/ApplicationDescription/anonymous None UserTokenPolicy arrays.

UASC MSG ServiceFault, namespace0 binary service ID397, complete ResponseHeader with service-result bit31 set, matching the current bounded codec check (not a complete assigned StatusCode validator); tied to the declared GetEndpoints request.
Implementation-profile UASC CLO, namespace0 binary service ID452 and complete RequestHeader, bound channel/token, no reply. Normative Part6 empty-body wording is unresolved.

The codec consumes the complete final chunk with no trailing bytes, enforces UTF-8 and signed Int32 String/ByteString/array lengths (-1 null), and rejects partial/abort chunks. Native parser budget is 1 MiB; StateAFL replay/request wire limits remain separate.

Every parsed array is limited to -1(null)..64 entries; DiagnosticInfo nesting is limited to depth8. Conditional subfields and array traversal are handled by the codec; structure_model is explanatory metadata.

Request authentication token must be namespace0 numeric null NodeId; AdditionalHeader must be null NodeId plus encoding0. SecurityPolicy None requires null certificate/thumbprint/nonce; EndpointDescription is None with null certificate and anonymous UserTokenPolicy only.

The executor records HEL/ACK limits and requires ACK ReceiveBufferSize<=HEL SendBufferSize and ACK SendBufferSize<=HEL ReceiveBufferSize. Submitted and received secure final chunks obey negotiated buffer limits; service-body size obeys the receiving peer MaxMessageSize. MaxMessageSize0 and MaxChunkCount0 mean unlimited; this codec admits exactly one final chunk, so every allowed nonzero MaxChunkCount admits it. Protocol version is fixed0 by the profile; there is no general version negotiation or multi-chunk assembly.

The bounded executor permits fresh None Issue only, correlates response request ID/handle, binds the assigned channel/token and checks exact-next client and server sequences independently after each direction's first sequence. Token expiration is conservatively measured from the local OPN submission time plus RevisedLifetime; unavailable/backward clocks, overflow, expired bindings, replay and skipped sequences are refused without consuming pending. ServiceFault completes the declared service transaction. CLO closes and clears the local token without response. The profile reconnects at UInt32 sequence exhaustion; Renew, overlap and rollover are not implemented.

The body field and structure_model preserve complete examples/shape; opaque whole-body replacement is not a supported codec operation. Supported variable mutation uses located String/ByteString/NodeId leaves.
